repair_rule: For each AM group, keep one existing FF and clone its complete master/D/CLK/SETN/RESETN tuple for each of the other three output ports. Same source capture edge; no output edge/extra relay. Repartition every upstream driver and reset recursively, including added copies, then rerun source equivalence and occupied-reset/native miter.
pin_assignment_scope: The lower bound rejects the explicit full-face coordinates in floorplan.json. A different assignment could reduce the bound but cannot establish historical dedicated face identity.
